content.user_title: Harden Security Across Apps and Infrastructure
content.value_statement: Security programs often miss gaps across code, infrastructure, identity, and compliance. This skill coordinates assessment, remediation, validation, and monitoring work.
actual_capabilities: Plans SAST, DAST, dependency audit, secrets scanning, and SBOM generation.
Guides threat modeling with STRIDE, attack trees, MITRE ATT&CK mapping, and risk prioritization.
Coordinates fixes for common web, API, authentication, dependency, and secrets issues.
Defines hardening controls for backend, frontend, mobile, identity, infrastructure, and monitoring layers.
Maps validation work to OWASP ASVS, CIS, SOC2, GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS requirements.
limitations: It requires explicit authorization before any security testing or environment changes.
It does not replace a qualified penetration tester or legal compliance review.
It may need adaptation for each cloud provider, technology stack, and risk tolerance.
Some suggested tools require licenses, setup, credentials, or controlled test environments.

use_cases.title: Create a Security Baseline
use_cases.description: Run coordinated scanning, threat modeling, architecture review, and risk ranking before remediation starts.

use_cases.title: Harden a Delivery Pipeline
use_cases.description: Add security checks, secrets controls, dependency review, and monitoring to CI/CD and deployment workflows.

use_cases.title: Prepare Compliance Evidence
use_cases.description: Map security controls and validation results to frameworks needed for audits and customer assurance.

prompt_templates.title: Assess My Application
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to assess my application for common security risks. Prioritize findings by severity and explain the safest remediation order.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Defense In Depth
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a defense-in-depth plan for my service. Cover code, identity, secrets, infrastructure, monitoring, and compliance.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Remediation Work
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to convert these security findings into a remediation program. Include owners, dependencies, validation steps, and rollback needs.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Enterprise Controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to validate controls against OWASP ASVS, CIS, SOC2, and PCI-DSS. Produce an evidence checklist and residual risk summary.

output_examples.input: Assess a web application before public launch.
output_examples.output: A prioritized report covering application vulnerabilities, dependency exposure, secrets risk, architecture gaps, and recommended remediation phases.

output_examples.input: Harden an API platform with sensitive customer data.
output_examples.output: A hardening plan for authentication, authorization, rate limiting, input validation, encryption, logging, monitoring, and incident response.

output_examples.input: Prepare evidence for a SOC2 readiness review.
output_examples.output: A control mapping that links security activities to audit evidence, validation steps, gaps, owners, and remediation priorities.

best_practices: Confirm written authorization, scope, and test windows before running security work.
Start with baseline scanning and threat modeling before changing production controls.
Validate each remediation with regression tests, security tests, and rollback plans.
anti_patterns: Do not run intrusive tests against production systems without approval.
Do not treat scanner output as final without manual triage and business context.
Do not add hardening controls without monitoring, ownership, and rollback procedures.

faq.question: Does this skill run security tools automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides orchestration guidance and prompts for authorized security assessment and hardening workflows.

faq.question: Can I use it for production systems?
faq.answer: Yes, but only with approval, a defined scope, planned windows, and rollback procedures.

faq.question: Which frameworks does it reference?
faq.answer: It references OWASP Top 10, OWASP ASVS, CIS Benchmarks, SOC2, GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS.

faq.question: Does it cover cloud infrastructure?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes network segmentation, WAF rules, security groups, DDoS controls, and monitoring integration.

faq.question: Is it suitable for compliance teams?
faq.answer: Yes. It can organize control validation, gap analysis, remediation evidence, and audit readiness tasks.

faq.question: What should users prepare first?
faq.answer: Prepare scope, authorization, architecture context, asset inventory, environment limits, and compliance requirements.
